goal: A profile leaves one Barkdown as a verified export and arrives in another as a new profile with its own database: notes, media, conversations, links and organization, without credentials.
scope: Export under the hold: a logical database dump, owned media and the profile files with a manifest
Import into a new profile: restore before first boot, navigation re-owned, credentials created on the importing side
The same from the app: Settings actions, progress, refusal reasons, interruption and resume
A second machine and another operating system when the Windows machine is back
acceptance: An export verifies against its manifest and carries no credential, owner key or machine-bound file
An import of that export serves the same Papers, revisions, blocks and media bytes on its own runtime and refuses the exporting runtime token
Navigation, conversations and drafts arrive owned by the importing library; the exported profile and the export folder are unchanged
An interrupted export or import leaves a journal that names its phase and can be resumed or discarded without touching an existing profile
A truncated, tampered or other-version export is refused before anything is created
nextAction: 1) A library left refusing changes (runtime in recovery after a writer died during a drain, or a hold nobody owns) is named in the app with one action that reopens it; rehearsed with a writer that dies inside the runtime. 2) Carried from C083: the Windows return checkpoint and a real library (about 2026-10-05), the decision on pre-existing cloud references. 3) A second machine and another operating system when the Windows machine is back.
truthReview: 2026-09-29: export and import are Settings actions, rehearsed in Electron on macOS with the imported profile opened. A host killed with SIGKILL is rehearsed three ways: idle (the runtime is reclaimed by its launch record), in the middle of an export (named, discarded, exported again) and in the middle of an import (listed, not selectable, imported again). Five refusals (tampered, truncated, added to, other version, not an export) are rehearsed from Settings and create nothing; an export folder opened in a file manager still imports. One stall point per operation; the folder picker and the system trash are stubbed in those rehearsals; the Windows reclaim path is written and not rehearsed; no second machine is claimed.
screenshotReview: Visual run 2026-09-29T13-56-30-158Z approved: 46 entries pixel-identical to the previous approved run. Refusal reasons, the interrupted-export notice and the unfinished-import row were inspected in the live rehearsal screenshots.

remaining: A visible way back for a library that refuses changes
